source_vs_publication: source_sha256/source_bytes describe unmodified local originals; published_sha256/published_bytes describe the selected, sanitized UTF-8/LF copies. These hashes must not be conflated.
selection_policy: Identity-based filters fixed in the packaging program; negative and positive results retained equally.
numeric_policy: JSON numeric values remain parsed numbers without arithmetic/rounding; CSV numeric cells remain source strings.
published_code_scope: Current publication-time Python source provenance, including shared original logic. This is not a retrospective pretest dependency lock; use each original freeze for that claim.
